title: decision: external_receivers is a component, not a GroupContext extension
description:
Mark 2026-11-26: guess the Right Thing and go with it. Item 1 of bead
mimid-1wgh.44.22, which is held for posting to the author.

## The ambiguity

draft-mahy-mls-semiprivatemessage-08 says both things:

- §1 L123-124 and §3 L150 call external_receivers "the external_receivers
  GroupContext extension", and say its construction "mirrors the syntax
  of the external_senders extension in [RFC9420]".
- §5.2 L418 registers it as an "MLS Component Type", though with the
  Extension Types template ("Message(s): GC", L427). The author's own
  coordination gist lists component 0x0007 external_receivers.

The two readings differ in how the list changes: a component is changed
by AppDataUpdate, an extension by GroupContextExtensions
(mls-extensions-11 §4.7).

## Chosen: a component

Three reasons, the third decisive for mimid.

1. The author's IANA section and his coordination gist both say
   component. The prose calling it a "GroupContext extension" reads as
   language predating mls-extensions' component model, since §3's
   comparison is to external_senders, which is an RFC 9420 extension
   because RFC 9420 has no components.

2. The suggested codepoint only works as a component. 0x0007 is free in
   the component registry, and as an extension type it collides with
   mls-extensions-11's supported_wire_formats (0x0007 suggested, -11 txt
   L1620). A reading that makes the author's own codepoint unusable is
   the wrong reading.

3. As an extension, external_receivers could never be changed in a mimid
   room. Decision mimid-1wgh.6.2 has the hub refuse every
   GroupContextExtensions proposal, so the list would be fixed at room
   creation for ever. As a component it is changed by AppDataUpdate,
   which is the path mimid already uses for did_webvh_heads (decisions
   mimid-1wgh.4.81.33, .34) and which the hub already accepts.

## Consequences

- mimi-mls reads and writes external_receivers as an app_data_dictionary
  component, not a GroupContext extension.
- Adding or removing an external receiver is an AppDataUpdate proposal,
  so it rides in a Commit the hub accepts, and the two implementations
  that cannot parse AppDataUpdate (stock mls-rs, didwebvh-mls-rs.md) are
  removed by such a Commit exactly as they are for a record change.
- If the WG settles on the extension form instead, this is a codepoint
  and a proposal type to change, not a design: the ExternalReceiver
  struct and the decryption path are the same either way.

## Still to put to the author

Bead mimid-1wgh.44.22 item 1 stays open: the draft should say one thing,
and the 0x0007 collision is worth telling him about whichever way he
goes. This decision is what mimid does meanwhile, not a claim about what
the draft means.
